questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words. The act of thinking now about something in the past
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.

The act of thinking now about something in the past
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Retrospection'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate meaning of the given group of words is 'Retrospection'.
  • Retrospection: the act of thinking now about something in the past (अतीत में किसी चीज के बारे में सोचने की क्रिया)
    • Example: Retrospection just isn't in his nature.
  • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1.
    ​

Correct Answer: Retrospection.

Additional Information

  • Let's look at the meaning of other words given in the Options:
Words Meaning
Circumspection the quality of being careful not to take risks (जोखिम न लेने के प्रति सावधान रहने का गुण)
Introspection examination of and attention to your own ideas, thoughts, and feelings (अपने स्वयं के विचारों, विचारों और भावनाओं की परीक्षा और ध्यान देना)
Inspection

the act of looking at something carefully, or an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is correct and legal (किसी चीज़ को ध्यान से देखने की क्रिया, या किसी भवन या संगठन की आधिकारिक यात्रा यह जाँचने के लिए कि सब कुछ सही और कानूनी है)

questions.question: Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words. speed greater than that of sound
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.

speed greater than that of sound
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'supersonic.'

Key Points

  • Let us explore the marked option: 
    • 'Supersonic' means involving or denoting a speed greater than that of sound. (पराध्‍वनिक, वायुगतिकीय)
      • For example - There was a huge bang; it sounded like a supersonic jet.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Additional Information

  •  Let us explore the other options:
    • Cacophonic means harsh or jarring sound. (कठोर या कर्कश ध्वनि)
      • For example - He uses sounds ranging from romantic pop songs to cacophonic clangor.
    • Harmonic means (in music) used to describe the way notes are played or sung together to make a pleasing sound. (संगीत में, जिसमें स्‍वर-योजना सामंजस्‍यपूर्ण और मधुर प्रभावकारी हो; समस्‍वरित, सुस्‍वरात्‍मक)
      • For example - I loved the simple harmonic melodies and wondered why I seldom hear anything as good on the radio.
    • Subsonic means relating to or flying at a speed or speed less than that of sound. (ध्वनि की गति से कम गति से उड़ना)
      • For example - This airplane can go out to high subsonic speeds very easily without using an afterburner.

questions.question: Select the option which means the same as the group of words given. A place where Buddhist monks live
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option which means the same as the group of words given.

A place where Buddhist monks live
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'monastery.'

Key Points

  • 'Monastery' means a place where Buddhist monks live together. (वह स्थान जहाँ ऋषि-मुनि रहते हैं; मठ, विहार)
    • For example - He spent several years in the monastery disguised as a monk.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
Additional Information

  •  Let us explore the other options:
    • Stupa means a dome-shaped structure erected as a Buddhist shrine. (गुंबद के आकार का बौद्घ स्‍मारक)
      • For example - The stupa on Ogoy Island is said to contain religious books gold weapons and letters to all mankind.
    • Temple means a building where people pray to a god or gods. (मंदिर, देवालय, पूजा-स्‍थली)
      • For example - They went to pray in the temple.
    • Pagoda means a Buddhist temple in India or South-East Asia which usually is in the form of a tall tower with several levels, each of which has its own roof. (भारत या दक्षिण-पूर्व एशियाई देशों में एक बुर्ज तथा अनेक तलों वाला बौद्घ मंदिर जिसकी प्रत्‍येक तल की अपनी छत होती है)
      • For example - The guide pointed at a pagoda and told us that it was built hundreds of years ago.
